summary.intent: Finish hackathon project housekeeping: get ESLint clean, document cfo.ai evidence and README links, and prepare to run all P1 scenarios in the scenario sweep UI while an analysis job completed.
summary.outcome: ESLint reached 0 errors and 0 warnings. The cfo.ai evidence doc, README links and build log entry were written and committed. A P1 run script was prepared, but the transcript doesn't show it being executed.

repo: In ScenariosView, turning off the P2 and P3 filters makes the 'Start N shown' button run all P1 scenarios, so no select-all control is needed.
cfo.ai evidence lives in docs/cfoai/README.md and docs/evidence/cfoai-business-plan.png, and is linked from the main README.
hackathon.md serves as the build log and gets an entry for each milestone such as lint and cfo.ai.
workflow: While a long analysis runs in the background, do small independent tasks such as docs and commits, and poll progress between them.
Before launching a sweep, check whether scenarios run sequentially or in parallel so you can estimate the duration.

friction: The analysis ran long enough to need repeated polling with 'Check analysis progress'.
There was no obvious bulk-select control for scenarios, so the filter and run logic had to be read to find the workaround.
open_items: Run the P1 scenario sweep with the prepared script and review the results.
Analysis was still finishing and its output hadn't been reviewed when the transcript ended.
